name: cursive
description_en: A Text User Interface library for the Rust programming language
readme_excerpt: Cursive Cursive is a TUI (Text User Interface) library for rust. It uses the [crossterm] backend by default, but other backends are available. It allows you to build rich user interfaces for terminal applications. [crossterm]: https://github.com/crossterm-rs/crossterm Documentation It is designed to be safe and easy to use: Or to use the latest git version: Check out the other examples to get these results, and more: (Colors may depend on your terminal configuration.)
